description: Header file defining a template class for a double-buffered, threadblock-scoped GEMM kernel with dequantization, used in CUDA GPU programming, specifically within the CUTLASS library for matrix multiplication.

classes.name: DqMmaPipelined
classes.description: Template class implementing a double-buffered, threadblock-scoped GEMM with dequantization, inheriting from DqMmaBase, parameterized by problem shape, iterator types, data types, policy, and transformation types.

methods.name: DqMmaPipelined
methods.description: Constructor initializing shared storage, thread, warp, and lane indices, setting up dequantizer and shared memory iterators, and computing warp offsets within the threadblock.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Performs the threadblock-scoped matrix multiply-accumulate operation with dequantization, managing shared memory loads, warp-level MMA, and synchronization.
